name: Hosted Agents — static gateway
summary: Self-provisioned Hosted Agent (code-deployed via remote_build) whose container code BYOM-routes through the static APIM gateway.
description: `project.beta.agents.create_version_from_code(...)` can remote-build an Invocations-protocol Hosted Agent whose container calls `responses.create(model='{static-connection}/{deployment}', ...)`. This lets users deploy custom agent code while still routing the model call through a static APIM AI Gateway connection.
notes:
Verified on the wire via the hosted-agent canary's static APIM probe. See `hosted-agents-canary` for the concrete proof and `test.py` for the remote-build variant.

The canary uses an `azd`-provisioned Foundry Hosted Agent registered by the `azure.ai.agents` extension; Invocations 2.0.0 calls `responses.create(model='{static-apim-conn}/gpt-4o-mini')` from inside the container and returns `ok:true`. This card keeps the inline `remote_build` path, where Foundry builds the container in place from an inline zip without ACR; that path is slower and cold-start-flaky.
